mechanisms:
Lowering
bashOutputMaxChars and taskOutputMaxChars to force truncation of verbose CLI
logs to disk

Setting skillListingBudgetFraction and skillOverrides to
name-only or user-invocable-only to reduce system prompt tokens

Prompt caching
on static prefix blocks providing 90-95% cost reductions (0.10-0.20/M
read)

Using /compact to summarize conversational history and strip redundant
tool iterations

Keeping CLAUDE.md and .claudeignore concise to avoid recurrent
per-turn prompt taxes

Routing search and grepping tasks to Haiku 5.5 under
the 100K token threshold

disable-model-invocation.use:
Prevents
model auto-triggering; removes skill from system prompt; reduces prompt tokens
to 0 until manually invoked

user-invocable.use:
Hides
skill from interactive slash (/) menu; reserves skill for autonomous agent-only
execution

when_to_use.use:
Injects extra semantic trigger
conditions into Claude's discovery
indexing

paths.use:
Scopes skill auto-invocation to
matching file patterns

context.use:
Executes skill inside
an isolated context window to prevent memory bloat in main
chat

agent.use:
Specifies subagent configuration to
execute forked context (e.g. Explore,
Architect)

background.use:
Runs forked context
asynchronously while user interacts in
foreground

model.use:
Overrides conversational model for
the duration of the skill turn (e.g.
claude-opus-5-5)

effort.use:
Sets reasoning and
deliberation budget (low, medium, high, xhigh, max) for the
skill

allowed-tools.use:
Pre-approves specific tool
executions and scopes (e.g. Bash(git
log:))

disallowed-tools.use:
Strips specific tools
from model access during skill execution to enforce read-only
sandboxes

hooks.use:
Registers lifecycle hooks
(PreToolUse, Stop) for deterministic command interception

Claude Code Slash-Command Autocomplete Guidelines

traps.colon_space:
Unquoted
colon followed by space (: ) triggers illegal inline mapping
error
traps.mid_string_comment:
Unquoted
space followed by hash ( #) strips subsequent text as an inline
comment
traps.yaml_1_1_norway_problem:
Unquoted boolean words (on, off, yes, no,
true, false) coerce to booleans, failing string validation on
name
traps.whitespace_rules:
Hard tabs (	) trigger YAMLParseError; frontmatter
must begin at line 1, column 0 with delimiter ---
traps.quotes:
Single quotes
require doubling ('') to escape apostrophes; double quotes require escaped
backslashes (\)
traps.safe_fallback:
Folded (>) or literal (|) block scalars
safely ingest colons, quotes, and symbols without
escaping
